description: FNPF 3D lake with dry land (G 10 1, geo.dat): a shore rising to land over the east third (a gentle beach 0-0.6 m above still water, then a slope) and an island, a third of the columns dry (bed above F 60 20 m), regular waves from the west (B 93 0.5 8.0, A 343 1), REEFMG (N 10 1) on 2 ranks (M 20 2: the east rank mostly dry). The Laplace solve skips the dry columns (reefmg_core active columns).
covers: reefmg_core::fine_activity, the loops of the solve over the active columns (aoff, acol)
coarsen_t: coarse columns without an active child
